title: Inbox rows are the real pages (Page class, Servex…)

message.text: Taken. First, the smallest version: one inbox row for the Page class that opens the real /framework/core/Page/ page in the detail area, full height, with the drawer following it (the page drawer confirmed how). Card folders stay as they are for everything else. The two questions (can any page render there; how a row knows its page) get answered here first. The sized-by-importance Overview comes next: the page mastermind gave the weight rule (1, 2 or 3 per card).

Live: the Page class is a row in your inbox, and clicking it opens the real /framework/core/Page/ page in the detail area, full height, tabs working. Try it: /framework/ai2/framework/core/Page/ . Servex works the same way. Your two questions: 1) Yes, any site page can show there as the same page, with no change to core; AI 2 asks the site router for it and moves its view in. 2) A row knows its page from its events: any log line that says "page": "/framework/core/Page/" bumps that page to the top. Picture: /framework/ai/2026-09-28/ai2-real-pages/shot-page-row-3440.png . Details: /framework/ai/2026-09-28/ai2-real-pages/answers.md . Tasks living in class folders: a proposal only, nothing moved: /framework/ai/2026-09-28/ai2-real-pages/proposal-tasks.md (for mastermind-servex-3). The drawer is told which page is open, but I cannot show it until the page drawer merges. Next: the Overview sized by importance.

Decided: a task about one page lives in that page's folder, at `<page>/ai/<date>-<slug>/`. I accepted ai2-lead-2's proposal with one change: the folder is `ai/`, not `tasks/`, because the drawer's sessions already live there and one folder per page keeps modules clean. That `ai/` folder stays out of the Docs tree and the file browser, and shows in the drawer's Sessions tab. A task that spans pages stays in `ai/<date>/`. Nothing old moves until you've seen it.

Ready to dispatch #16 after task-loop lands: role `task-mastermind`, name `task-placement`, `claude-sonnet-5`, medium, `bypassPermissions`, brief ai/2026-09-28/task-placement/requirements.md.

You asked what the small WORKSPACE word is. It is an experiment: on a card with tabs (like System design), it turns the card into a centred page with its own left nav. On other rows it does nothing, which is why it looked dead. Before (normal): /framework/ai/2026-09-28/ai2-workspace/shots/ai2w-system-design-3440-off.png . After (workspace on): /framework/ai/2026-09-28/ai2-workspace/shots/ai2w-system-design-3440-on.png . Fix under way: the word will show only where it works, labelled "Floating page view (try it)". Your real-page direction mostly supersedes it; say the word and I remove it.
